notes: The of before Israel is given to the appositional object marker under rule 16 rather than to the name as a supplied function word under rule 33, since rule 33's own limit defers to a marker standing on the phrase; rule 16 directs that the condition rather than the lemma of the English word decides it.
לִפְנֵי is split because the ASV writes from for the preposition and the presence for the construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet (rule 2).
